story.title: UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath Pledges to Make Uttar Pradesh India's Deep Tech Capital
story.summary: On National Technology Day, Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath committed to transforming UP into India's Deep Tech Capital, citing the state's rapid emergence as a hub for IT parks, manufacturing, and startups. The announcement reflects a concerted state-level push to attract AI and semiconductor investment to India's most populous state, which is already home to the HCL-Foxconn semiconductor joint venture in Jewar. The declaration adds political weight to UP's ambition to rival Bengaluru and Hyderabad as a technology destination.
